text:
Connor O'Brien: planning thread for Dedicated staged rollouts beta enablement. Need to lock: feature flag plan, migration timing, release train sequencing, and a quick validation checklist. Target is to have beta-ready bits on next train so CS can start onboarding 2 pilot tenants.

Talia Benson: thx. can we align on dates? PM side assumes: migrations early week, dogfood on Redwood dedicated pools mid-week, then flip allowlist for pilot customers end of week.

Connor O'Brien: yup. I’m trying to avoid “ship code + run migration same day” for control plane.

Ethan Park: control plane has new objects + state machine. migrations add: `rollout_plans`, `rollout_plan_versions`, `rollout_approval_events` (+ indices). We can ship code that’s read-tolerant before we start writing.

Chloe Martin: console backend depends on the new status aggregation endpoint. frontend can land behind the same flag but ideally doesn’t 404 if feature is off.

Mina Haddad: routing side is behind `dedicated_staged_rollouts` already (PR 28677). when flag off, we ignore plan + behave like current pool-level config.

Connor O'Brien: flag naming check:
- `dedicated_staged_rollouts` (master on/off)
- `dedicated_staged_rollouts_allowlist` (list of tenant_ids or pool_ids?)
We need to decide what we’re shipping.

Ethan Park: allowlist should be tenant-scoped for now. pool_id allowlisting gets messy with fleets recreating pools. We can still have an operator override to target a specific pool in emergencies.

Marcus Lin: +1 tenant-scoped. also: approvals/audit is a big part of beta story, so we should not allow “silent” enablement without audit events emitting.

Logan Wright: telemetry notes: gate evaluator depends on queue depth + utilization metrics being present. missing metrics should force HOLD (that’s in PR 28572). For beta we should ensure metrics pipeline is live for pilot tenants’ pools.

Sean Gallagher: SRE wants: evaluator health dashboard + alerting on evaluator lag BEFORE enabling customers. We got burned in dogfood when evaluator fell behind and stages advanced too far.

Keiko Yamamoto: autoscaling guardrails are behind `dedicated_rollout_headroom_guardrail` (separate toggle). Do we require it for beta? IMO yes for safety even if it’s conservative.

Connor O'Brien: I’d like beta gating to require:
- `dedicated_staged_rollouts` ON
- allowlist includes tenant
- headroom guardrail ON
If any of those missing, plan can exist but it will never auto-advance.

Mina Haddad: routing can do that. if guardrail is off, we can treat as “capability missing” and return HOLD status w/ reason.

Talia Benson: product is ok if we message it as “beta requires guardrails + evaluator healthy”. we just need it to be clear in UI why it’s held.

Chloe Martin: UI can show “Held: guardrail not enabled” and “Held: metrics stale” as separate badges. We already have placeholder reasons.

Dev Patel: support request: please include an internal-only “disable staged rollout for tenant” runbook step. when things go sideways we need an easy stop-the-line that doesn’t require code deploy.

Connor O'Brien: yup. “kill switch” is disable allowlist entry + disable stage advancement.

Rachel Kim: CS side: we’re drafting beta comms. we need a crisp sequence: when migrations happen, when they’ll see UI, and what’s the escalation path if a rollout pauses/holds.

Marcus Lin: audit log export: make sure events show up in the existing pipeline. we should validate that `rollout.approve`, `rollout.abort`, `rollout.auto_hold` are included in export + retention settings match Dedicated commitments.

Ethan Park: on migrations: safest path is
1) ship code with schema but no writes (read-compatible)
2) run DB migration in prod during low-traffic window
3) ship write paths + evaluator
4) enable flag for internal tenant(s)
5) then allowlist pilot tenants

Connor O'Brien: ok, proposing release train plan (tentative):
- Train r2024.50 (Tue): control plane schema + API read paths + routing no-op behavior + audit event definitions (emission gated)
- Wed 10:00 PT: run prod migrations (control plane DB)
- Train r2024.51 (Thu): write paths + evaluator + console backend + frontend (all still behind flags)
- Fri: internal dogfood allowlist (Redwood-owned dedicated tenant) then 2 pilot tenants if SRE sign-off

Sean Gallagher: migration window Wed 10 PT works. please coordinate with oncall. and we need a rollback plan if migration causes perf issues.

Connor O'Brien: rollback plan for migrations: we don’t roll back schema, just disable flags and stop writes. migrations are additive.

DeployBot: Scheduled change request created: "control-plane prod migration: dedicated staged rollouts tables" (window: Wed 10:00-10:30 PT). Approvers: @Sean Gallagher @Ethan Park

Keiko Yamamoto: what about guardrail config rollout? it touches autoscaling policy evaluation. can we ship that ahead of beta too?

Mina Haddad: routing/guardrails are already code-complete but default-off. enabling guardrail for all Dedicated might be risky; we can scope it to allowlisted tenants as well.

Connor O'Brien: scope guardrail to same allowlist for beta. later we can decide global default.

Talia Benson: +1. keeps blast radius small.

Logan Wright: metrics readiness checklist item: confirm pilot tenants’ pools have:
- `dedicated_pool_queue_depth` reporting
- `dedicated_pool_gpu_utilization` reporting
- `request_timeout_rate` (pool-dimension) reporting
If any missing, evaluator will HOLD and they’ll get stuck.

Chloe Martin: can we add a console preflight check on rollout creation? like “metrics present in last 15m” and warn.

Ethan Park: evaluator already computes “metrics_freshness” as part of gate summary. exposing preflight might be extra, but we can at least show warning on the plan page.

Connor O'Brien: ok, validation checklist for beta enablement (release + ops). please add gaps:
- [ ] Prod DB migrations applied (control plane) + no error spikes
- [ ] Feature flags present in config service (`dedicated_staged_rollouts`, allowlist, headroom guardrail)
- [ ] Create rollout plan in staging: Stage 1 5% -> Stage 2 25% -> Stage 3 100%
- [ ] Manual approval path works (RBAC enforced) + audit events emitted
- [ ] Gate fail path works: induce 5xx/latency => auto HOLD (no advance)
- [ ] Missing metrics path works: evaluator HOLD within 1 eval window (no advance)
- [ ] Routing determinism check: same request key sticks to same stage allocation across retries
- [ ] Guardrail check: headroom policy prevents advancing when pool near saturation
- [ ] Dashboards/alerts: evaluator lag + paused rollouts alerting enabled
- [ ] Support runbook published + escalation path pinned for CS/Support

Sean Gallagher: add: [ ] verify “stop-the-line” works even if evaluator is degraded (PR 28572). i.e. rollouts forced HOLD when evaluator unhealthy.

Marcus Lin: add: [ ] audit export validation: events visible in SIEM export sink within expected delay.

Dev Patel: add: [ ] internal CLI/admin tool can abort rollout for tenant (tested in staging). no console-only reliance.

Rachel Kim: add: [ ] pilot customer onboarding doc shared + named oncall rotation / slack channel for beta issues.

Connor O'Brien: perfect. I’ll paste this checklist into the launch checklist doc + link it in the change request. Action items:
- @Ethan Park confirm migration scripts final + estimate runtime
- @Sean Gallagher approve migration window + assign oncall coverage
- @Chloe Martin confirm console pages hide gracefully when flag off
- @Logan Wright confirm metrics present in pilot tenant pools (or list any gaps)
- @Marcus Lin confirm audit export wiring for new event types

Talia Benson: works. I’ll update PM-418 with this sequence and call out guardrail requirement for beta.

Mina Haddad: heads up: routing change needs config propagation time. allowlist flip won’t be instant; assume ~2-3 mins for all regions.

Connor O'Brien: good call. will add note: “wait 5 mins after allowlist update before expecting traffic split”.

Sean Gallagher: :thumbsup: just please don’t enable pilots late Fri unless we have someone on pager. we can do internal dogfood Fri, pilots Mon if needed.

Connor O'Brien: agreed. internal dogfood Fri, pilots Mon AM pending SRE go/no-go.
